## About P2S Academy

P2S Academy (أكاديمية P2S) — also written “P2S Academy – Path to Success” and
“طريقك لكلية التجارة” — is an Egyptian educational platform in Kafr El-Zayyat,
Gharbia, Egypt. It prepares commercial-diploma students for the
**معادلة كلية التجارة** (Faculty of Commerce Equivalency Exam), which is
organized by the **المجلس الأعلى للجامعات** (Supreme Council of Universities).

The academy helps diploma holders become eligible to enter the Faculty of
Commerce as university students. The program covers one exam, four subjects,
and one attempt.

- Founder and director: **Mr. Ahmed Ali** (مستر أحمد علي).
- Track record shown on the site: **28 past success models** (٢٨ نموذج نجاح).
- Location: كفر الزيات، الغربية، مصر (Kafr El-Zayyat, Gharbia, Egypt).
- Service area: Egypt.
- Languages: Arabic.
- Website: https://p2s-academy.com/

## What the academy offers

- In-person lectures 4 days per week.
- Recorded online lectures for review at any time.
- Printed notes and study booklets.
- Weekly tests to measure each student’s level and progress.
- Continuous assessment and identification of weak points.
- Weekly follow-up with parents/guardians.
- Training students to understand the curriculum and solve a subject exam in
  **30 minutes**.
- The stated goal is not just attending lectures, but being able to understand
  the material and solve the exam quickly, calmly, and confidently.

## The equivalency exam (معادلة كلية التجارة)

### Common facts

- Organizer: Supreme Council of Universities (المجلس الأعلى للجامعات).
- Purpose: allow commercial-diploma holders to continue university education
  and enter the Faculty of Commerce.
- Attempts: one attempt.
- Format: multiple-choice questions (MCQ).
- Number of subjects: 4.
- Time: one hour per subject.
- Pass mark: **50% in each subject separately** — not an average. One subject
  below 50% closes the whole path.
- The exam is offered for the 2026/2027 cycle.

### 3-year commercial diploma (دبلوم تجارة ٣ سنين)

Eligibility:

- Any student with a **3-year commercial technical diploma**
  (دبلوم فني تجاري ٣ سنين).
- Graduation cohorts: **2026 and 2027**.
- Overall grade: **70% or higher** (٧٠٪ أو أكتر).

Subjects:

1. Mathematics (الرياضيات) — algebra, ratios, sequences, and fast solving.
2. English (اللغة الإنجليزية) — grammar, vocabulary, and reading comprehension.
3. Organizational Behavior (السلوك التنظيمي) — individual and group behavior
   inside organizations.
4. Information Technology (تكنولوجيا المعلومات) — computer, network, and
   information fundamentals.

After passing:

- Nomination is for the **first year** (الفرقة الأولى) of the Faculty of
  Commerce in public universities, after meeting admission rules. The student
  then completes university study from the beginning, like a secondary-school
  student.

When to start:

- Start **immediately after the diploma exams**, without waiting for results or
  the coordination/placement process.
- Attendance is **free before results are announced**.

Documents to prepare:

- Diploma certificate (شهادة الدبلوم).
- Certified transcript / grade statement (بيان درجات معتمد).
- Copy of the national ID card (صورة بطاقة الرقم القومي).
- Two recent personal photos (صورتان شخصيتان حديثان).
- Application form (استمارة التقديم).
- Fee payment receipt (إيصال سداد الرسوم).

The document list can change from year to year. The academy reviews it with the
student before the deadline.

If the overall grade is below 70%:

- 70% is the basic requirement for the equivalency.
- Some cases may be nominated through the coordination process or a different
  path. The academy advises contacting them with the actual grade rather than
  paying for a closed path.

### 5-year commercial diploma and 2-year technical institutes
(نظام الخمس سنوات والمعاهد الفنية التجارية)

Eligibility:

- Holders of a **5-year commercial technical school diploma**
  (دبلوم المدارس الفنية التجارية نظام الخمس سنوات).
- Holders of a **2-year commercial technical institute diploma**
  (دبلوم المعاهد الفنية التجارية نظام السنتين).

Subjects:

1. Commercial Studies in English (دراسات تجارية باللغة الإنجليزية).
2. Accounting (المحاسبة).
3. Information Technology (تكنولوجيا المعلومات).
4. Mathematical Statistics (الإحصاء الرياضي).

After passing:

- The student enters the **second year** (الفرقة الثانية) of the Faculty of
  Commerce directly.

Importance:

- The equivalency is the student’s opportunity to complete university education
  and obtain a Bachelor of Commerce (بكالوريوس تجارة).

### Yearly change disclaimer

Conditions, dates, subjects, and required documents can change every year
according to decisions of the Supreme Council of Universities and the
coordination office. P2S Academy updates the site when changes are announced
and confirms details with each student before applying.

## Packages and prices

The site’s structured data lists three packages (EGP):

| Package | Arabic name | Price |
|---|---|---|
| Starter | البداية | 1,200 EGP |
| Comprehensive | المتكاملة | 2,000 EGP |
| Individual | الفردية | 3,500 EGP |

Prices and dates must be confirmed with the academy before payment.

## Booking / free consultation

The site includes a free booking form asking for:

- Name.
- Mobile / WhatsApp number.
- Diploma type: 3-year or 5-year commercial diploma.
- Graduation year: 2026 or 2027.
- Governorate.

The academy reviews the student’s certificate and graduation year, then explains
eligibility and the next step. Submitting the form does not create a payment
obligation. The site states that phone numbers are not published or shared.

Direct booking/contact link: https://wa.me/201030263066

## Frequently asked questions

### 3-year diploma

**Who can apply for the equivalency from a 3-year diploma?**
Any student with a 3-year commercial technical diploma from the 2026 or 2027
cohorts with an overall grade of 70% or higher. The academy reviews the
certificate and graduation year and confirms eligibility before any payment.

**After passing, does the student enter the first or second year?**
Nomination is for the first year of the Faculty of Commerce in public
universities after meeting admission rules. The student completes university
study from the beginning.

**How many days does the exam take?**
One hour per subject, four subjects, all multiple-choice. No essay memorization
is required; understanding, time management, and question practice make the
difference.

**Is passing per subject or based on the total?**
Passing is **50% per subject**, not an average. One subject below 50% closes the
whole path, so the academy works on the student’s weakest subject from the
start.

**My overall grade is below 70% — is there hope?**
70% or higher is the basic requirement. Some cases may be nominated through
coordination or a different path. Contact the academy with the actual grade for
an honest assessment.

**What documents should I prepare?**
Diploma certificate, certified transcript, copy of the national ID, two recent
personal photos, application form, and fee payment receipt. The list changes
yearly and is reviewed with the student before the deadline.

**When exactly should I start?**
Immediately after the diploma exams, without waiting for results or coordination.
Starting early gains time for understanding, revision, and practice. Attendance
before results are announced is free.

### 5-year diploma / 2-year institutes

**What is the Faculty of Commerce equivalency?**
An exam affiliated with the Supreme Council of Universities that gives students
the opportunity to complete university education and join the Faculty of
Commerce.

**Who is allowed to apply?**
Holders of a 5-year commercial technical school diploma and holders of a 2-year
commercial technical institute diploma.

**What are the exam subjects?**
Four subjects: Commercial Studies in English, Accounting, Information
Technology, and Mathematical Statistics.

**Which year does the student enter after passing?**
The second year of the Faculty of Commerce directly.

**Why is the equivalency important?**
It is the student’s real opportunity to complete university education and obtain
a Bachelor of Commerce.
